step: S10A fa185: Faint Attack (185) per-side optional restore lag at 205 -> faithful timing (ISSUES #152 'Faint Attack (185) short bodies')
derivation: Move_FAINT_ATTACK ends `clearmonbg ANIM_ATTACKER; delay 1; restorebg; waitbgfadein; end` (data/battle_anim_scripts.s:5186-5190). Cmd_restorebg (src/battle_anim.c:1217) creates Task_FadeToBg (tBackgroundId -1): state 0 (:1150-1155) BeginHardwarePaletteFade(0xE8, 0, 0, 16, 0) = the BG3 fade to black (reducer ages 184..199); state 1 (:1158-1162) when the fade ends; state 2 (:1163-1175) LoadDefaultBg -> DrawMainBattleBackground (the battle-terrain VRAM decompress) AND BeginHardwarePaletteFade(0xE8, 0, 16, 0, 1) = the default-BG swap and the 16-step fade-in, in the same task step; state 3 (:1178-1182) DestroyTask + sAnimBackgroundFadeState = 0, which releases Cmd_waitbgfadein (:1243) and `end`. The optional lag (body age 205) is the decompress frame overrunning VBlank under the black screen (display-neutral itself), so without it everything from the state-2 step on runs one frame earlier: the reducer profile's defaultBgSwapAge 204 -> 203 and doneAge 219 -> 218 (faintAttack.ts faintAttackRestoreProfile), every earlier age unchanged, the live window 221 -> 220 rows; the wrong phase differs exactly on ages 203..218 (the swap row + 15 fade-in rows). Not fitted: the residual of both other-phase windows equals this shift.
